headline: Tax abatements totaling $22,312.67 and $152,458.08, a Piccadilly LLC tax stabilization request, and a pay rate ordinance for Local 3960.
summary: The agenda covers tax abatements for April through September 2026. It also includes a tax stabilization request for 30 Beecher Street and changes to pay rates for Local 3960.
items: Public input period; sign in or join by Zoom 10 minutes before the meeting
Resolution to abate taxes for motor vehicles, real estate, and tangible personal property for April, May, and June 2026, totaling $22,312.67
Resolution to abate taxes for motor vehicles, real estate, and tangible personal property for July, August, and September 2026, totaling $152,458.08
Tax assessor's communication on the Piccadilly LLC tax stabilization agreement request for 30 Beecher Street, AP 45, Lot 445
Ordinance to repeal and replace the pay rate schedule for Local 3960 in Section §88-12 of the city code (Finance & Grant Compliance Assistant)
location: City Council Conference Room (Room 140), Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 1st Floor, Pawtucket, Rhode Island

AGENDA 
 
 
TO:  All Members of the Finance Committee 
  William Keegan, Acting HR Director 
  Robert Burns, Tax Assessor 
  Aurora Leigh, for Piccadilly LLC 
   
FROM:       Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, City Clerk 
 
DATE:          November 19, 2026 
 
SUBJECT: FINANCE COMMITTEE  
________________________________ 
 
You are requested to attend a  meeting of the City Council Finance Committee, to be held on Tuesday, 
November 24, 2026, at 6:00 p.m., at the Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 1st Floor, City 
Council Conference Room - Room 140, Pawtucket, Rhode Island. 
 
The purpose of this meeting is for discussion and/or consideration of the following: 
 
 
1. PUBLIC INPUT PERIOD Must Sign-in or Join via Zoom 10 minutes prior to meeting. 
 
2. RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE ABATEMENT OF TAXES FOR MOTOR VEHICLES, 
REAL ESTATE AND TANGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY FOR APRIL, MAY, AND JUNE 
2026, IN THE TOTAL AMOUNT OF $22,312.67.  
 
3. RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE ABATEMENT OF TAXES FOR MOTOR VEHICLES, 
REAL ESTATE AND TANGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY FOR JULY, AUGUST, AND 
SEPTEMBER 2026, IN THE TOTAL AMOUNT OF $152,458.08.  
 
4. Communication from Robert Burns, Tax Asses sor, to the Honorable Terrence E. Mercer, City 
Council President (Piccadilly LLC Tax Stabilization Agreement Request for 30 Beecher Street, AP 
45, Lot 445) 
 
5. AN ORDINANCE REPEALING AND REPLACING THE SCHEDULE OF PAY RATES FOR 
LOCAL 3960 IN SECTION §88 -12 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES OF THE CITY OF 
PAWTUCKET, 1996. (Finance & Grant Compliance Assistant)  
 
This meeting is being called by Councilor Mark J. Wildenhain, Chair, Finance Committee.
